title: RevocationReport
description:
Report of a revocation or an Emergency Stop: distinguishes the discarded queue
from requests already forwarded (ROADMAP 7.3). It promises no cancellations.

already_forwarded.description: Operations already forwarded to the backend: they may have produced effects.

discarded.description: Queued operations discarded without forwarding (no effect).

OperationId.description: OperationId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.
